title: Resource pack
description: A resource pack's manifest (#1860): its id, its name, its own version, the game version it targets, and the resources it provides (textures, models, regions, region pieces, realms, quests, species, translation catalogues, tile blueprints, loot tables and materials), each by its id. The game's own resources are the default pack; a player's pack (#1858) shares this format. One file per pack, named after its id.

id.description: Stable: lowercase words joined by underscores.

game_version.description: The game version the pack targets, major.minor.patch.

textures.description: Each texture's file by its id, relative to the pack's root (res:// for the default pack), never climbing out of it.

models.description: Each model's file (#1864), a .glb or .gltf, by its id, relative to the pack's root, never climbing out of it. The images a model uses come with it.

regions.description: Each region drawn whole in one Markdown file (#1861), by its id (an instance blueprint's or a variant's region), relative to the pack's root, never climbing out of it.

region_pieces.description: Each region arranged from region pieces (#1861), by its id: its pieces' Markdown files, relative to the pack's root, the start piece among them unless it's a variant that changes only some of its blueprint's pieces (#1590).

realms.description: Each realm's Markdown file (#1861), by its id, relative to the pack's root, never climbing out of it. The game plays every realm a pack has.

quests.description: Each quest's JSONC file (#1888), in the quests slice's quest format (slices/quests/data/quests.schema.json), by its id, relative to the pack's root, never climbing out of it. The players can take every quest a pack has.

species.description: Each species' JSONC file (#1903), in the species' format (species.schema.json in the species slice), by its id, relative to the pack's root, never climbing out of it. The game has every species a pack has.

translations.description: Each language's gettext catalogue (#1902), a .po file, by its locale in lower case (de, pt_br), relative to the pack's root, never climbing out of it. The game registers every catalogue a pack has; a text a catalogue doesn't translate shows as its English source.

tiles.description: Each tile kind's blueprint (#1901), a JSONC file in the core's tile blueprint format (core/data/schemas/tiles.schema.json), by its id, relative to the pack's root, never climbing out of it. The rules know every tile kind a pack has; changing a kind's traits changes the rules.

loot_tables.description: Each loot table's JSONC file (#1953), in the loot slice's loot table format (slices/loot/data/loot_tables.schema.json), by its id, relative to the pack's root, never climbing out of it. The game reads every loot table a pack has; what rolls on one names it by id.

materials.description: Each material's JSONC file (#1953), in the loot slice's material format (slices/loot/data/materials.schema.json), by its id, relative to the pack's root, never climbing out of it. The game reads every material a pack has; a loot table names one by id.
